subject.title: fix(auth-profiles): preserve secret refs and OAuth fields during doctor auth migration

question: Should this focused doctor auth migration field-preservation fix land as-is after owner review, or should maintainers require broader shipped-shape coverage before merge?
rationale: The code fix is narrow and appears correct, but it changes how legacy credential material is preserved into SQLite during upgrades, which is a compatibility and security-boundary-sensitive migration choice.

options.title: Land after owner pass
options.body: Accept the focused fix with the existing before/after proof and tests, then handle adjacent auth migration bugs in their own PRs.

options.title: Add broader shipped-shape coverage
options.body: Require one more regression around an observed shipped auth-profile/auth.json shape before merge to lower upgrade uncertainty.

options.title: Bundle adjacent migration fixes
options.body: Pause this PR only if maintainers want to intentionally combine it with the separate open legacy-flat store merge or runtime lazy-import work.

recommendation.title: Land after owner pass
recommendation.body: Accept the focused fix with the existing before/after proof and tests, then handle adjacent auth migration bugs in their own PRs.

likelyOwner.reason: This is the strongest available routing candidate from merged SQLite auth-profile migration history and current persisted auth-profile ownership signals.
